spec.description:
Earthwool Roof Blanket (with reflective foil laminate / Space
Blanket) is a glass mineral wool roll insulation factory-bonded to a reflective
foil facing, designed for thermal performance, condensation control, and
acoustic absorption under metal roofs. Manufactured with ECOSE Technology using
bio-based binders and up to 80% recycled glass, it significantly reduces radiant
heat gain and exterior rain drumming noise. The reflective foil facing acts as a
vapor barrier and radiant barrier, protecting metal roof assemblies from
condensation damage while complying with NCC fire and bushfire standards up to
BAL-40.
features:
Factory-laminated with reflective foil facing including
a 150mm overlap flap

Dual thermal and acoustic performance: slows heat flow
and dampens rain impact drumming

Controls condensation formation on the
underside of metal roof sheeting

Non-combustible glass mineral wool core
complying with AS 1530.1

ECOSE Technology bio-based binder with no added
formaldehyde or harsh chemicals

Tested to AS 1530.2 with a low Flammability
Index (≤ 5)

Suitable for sealing ember entry points in bushfire zones up to
BAL-40 under AS 3959
Made using up to 80% recycled glass

Soft to handle,
low dust, and odorless

Group 1 fire classification compliant with AS 5637.1 /
AS ISO 9705

install:
Roll out blanket over roof
purlins, rafters, or safety wire mesh with reflective foil facing downward
towards building interior

Overlap adjacent rolls using the factory 150mm foil
flap

Tape all foil lap joints continuously with 72mm reinforced aluminum foil
tape to maintain vapor barrier integrity

Allow a nominal 40mm drape between
purlins to promote condensation drainage towards eaves if unmeshed

Fasten
metal roofing sheets directly over the blanket through to purlins

Ensure
blanket terminates neatly at gutter line without obstructing stormwater flow
selection_checklist:
Confirm roof type (pitched or curved metal deck roof,
shed, or commercial warehouse)

Select required R-value (R1.3 to R3.6) to meet
NCC roof energy compliance

Choose foil duty rating (Light, Medium, or Heavy
Duty) based on span and roof traffic

Calculate total roof area
including 150mm overlap allowance

Order matching 72mm reinforced foil tape
and safety wire mesh
limitations: Must not be left exposed to rain or weather prior to roof sheet installation

Foil lap joints must be taped continuously to maintain vapor barrier
performance

For tropical high-humidity climates, verify condensation design
before installing foil facing inward

retrieval.rag_summary:
Knauf Blanket Roof
Lamin (Earthwool Roof Blanket / Space Blanket) is a glass mineral wool
insulation blanket factory-laminated to a reflective foil facing with a 150mm
overlap flap. Engineered for installation under residential and commercial metal
roofs, it prevents condensation, reflects radiant heat, and dampens rain impact
drumming noise. Manufactured with bio-based ECOSE Technology, non-combustible
core (AS 1530.1), and low-flammability foil (Index ≤ 5, BAL-40 compliant), it
delivers ratings from R1.3 to R3.6 backed by a 50-year warranty.
